payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_spec_id_lock_callers.py::test_a_layer_cell_beside_a_held_spec_id_raises_before_any_runtime_call failed with the spec's wrong version 'The lock is released, through an `ExitStack` closed at the top of the `finally`, before `cell_down`.' applied to saffron/end_review.py only by raising "saffron.cell_name_lock.LockHeld: SY-1's cell is held by pid 153596's a layer cell (end_review.layer_cell)", and no assertion failed. The claim was "`layer_cell` raises `cell_name_lock.LockHeld` before any runtime call while another process holds its layer's spec id. Otherwise it holds the lock, with the text `a layer cell (end_review.layer_cell)`, from before its first runtime call until its block exits by raise or by return. The witness holds the lock in this process with a spy at `runtime._call`. Held as `SY-1`, a layer cell for `SY-1`, and one for `sy-1`, each raise `LockHeld` naming the holder's pid and text, and the spy records nothing. Beside a holder of `SY-2`, the spy's first call is `rm -f saffron-endreview-SY-1`, and a take of `SY-1` there is refused naming that text. A take succeeds after the spy's raise. With `cell_up`, `cell_down` and `remove_container` faked, a take inside the block is refused, and so is one inside `cell_down`. One after the block exits succeeds.".
